input: An explicit private Real representation name and eight bytes of generator parameters; each probe runs in a fresh process.
input_parameters: nonzero signed rational scale with independently variable numerator and denominator widths
odd-prime-denominator angles strictly between zero and one half
exact decimal rational offsets near pi
outputs: per-query raw dispatch counts and timing samples
independently directed MPFR interval and sign checks
lexicase case order and survivor trace for each selection
complete generated/selected input and failure records
selection: Independent populations for every private Real representation. Each selection shuffles query cases, keeps only the currently worst observed candidates on that case, and randomly breaks remaining ties after all cases. Every filter step is replayable.
validation_before_campaign: selector tests contrasting lexicase with average ranking, tie handling, bucket independence, malformed inputs, and replay tampering
workspace formatting and strict Clippy for all affected targets/features
AddressSanitizer and LeakSanitizer qualification with retained dispatch traces
remaining_campaign_gates: Freeze campaign size, rounds, seeds, process limits, all raw samples, and selection criteria before execution
Run a genuinely mutating campaign across all 22 independent representation populations
Replay selected cases and retain any failure as a deterministic regression
Run proportionate competitive benchmarks on the retained cases with matching input and numerical result contracts
scope_limits: This first implementation concerns scalar representations. Directed predicate, curve, mesh, binding, and machine populations remain part of the full plan.
Finite campaign success is not exhaustive-input proof or completion of P38.
No existing full-resolution fixture, closed experiment, or numerical report is replaced.
This adds development tooling; production arithmetic and public APIs stay outside its change set.
